summary: Learn AI for customer service, automation, and contact centre KPIs with practical templates, dashboards, and service workflows. Enrol now.
lede: AI for Customer Service and Contact Centre Automation is a practical, intermediate-level course for applying AI tools, automation workflows, and service governance to contact centre operations. You will learn to assess service processes, identify automation opportunities, and use capabilities such as intent classification, omnichannel routing, chatbots, knowledge article optimisation, sentiment analysis, quality monitoring, and escalation management to support consistent customer experiences. The course helps you connect service design to measurable outcomes, including average handle time, first contact resolution, containment rate, customer satisfaction, and agent utilisation. Through practical work on chatbot use-case inventories, service journeys, AI-assisted knowledge workflows, human-in-the-loop escalation models, dashboards, prompt design, and conversation analytics, you will learn to improve support operations while maintaining service guardrails and customer empathy.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who manage customer interactions, service workflows, and support quality in AI-enabled contact centres.
modules: Chatbot Use Cases and Intent Design
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of customer service, contact centre operations, or CX reporting; familiarity with basic service KPIs such as average handle time, first contact resolution, and customer satisfaction; and comfort using spreadsheets or service dashboards. No programming is required, and advanced AI concepts are taught at an operational application level rather than an engineering level. If your team already uses a CRM, help desk, or contact centre platform, bring examples of current workflows, escalation rules, and quality monitoring reports for discussion.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
